name: Vice Got a Price!
guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops automatically. It is the last trophy you will unlock.

name: A Long Road
guide: Finish the 100% Completion checklist, which appears under Progress > Stats after the story. PowerPyx rates the platinum at about 200 hours, and most of that time is spent here, so work on checklist items as you play instead of leaving them all for the end.

name: Cunning Stunts
guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida: jumps, under-bridge flights, Knife Flights and base jumps. Stunt locations show on the map, so clear them in batches while you explore each region.

name: Master of None
description: Try each type of activity once.
guide: Try all nine activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. One try of each is enough, so sample everything early and the trophy pops quickly.

name: The Shootist
description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Learn each range's target pattern first, then go for gold; the ranges stay open after the story, so there is no rush.

name: Top Fun
description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Learn the course on a practice run, then race for the win; the drone handles the same everywhere, so it is mostly about knowing the corners.

name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 available. Pick the short street races first and use the best car you own for each one; wins on the same race do not count twice.

name: Baited My Tackle
description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
guide: Beat Cal in a fishing contest. His questline starts in Chapter 1, so take the fishing challenges when they appear and keep your line tension steady instead of reeling hard the whole time.

name: Stick Fiddler
guide: Finish any one of the four arcade games. Three of them are on the TV at home, so you can do this from the couch whenever you want a break from the street.

name: Strangers & Freaks
description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
guide: Finish eight Strangers & Freaks questlines across Leonida. They appear as purple icons on the map, plus black icons with pink letters. Take each strand when it shows up; the checklist does not require them, so they are easy to leave behind.

name: Positive Mental Attitude
description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
guide: Meditate at all 18 Meditation Spots. Do the first one with Lucia at Jason's house in Chapter 1: after an early Chapter 1 mission she mentions meditation in the kitchen one morning and heads out to the balcony. Follow her, accept the prompt, and she shows you how it works. That first meditation may be the only one you cannot repeat, so do it when it is offered. The meditation counter in the Progress menu tracks your progress.

name: Don't Touch My Deck
guide: Complete three Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets to find across Leonida, so pick the three whose cards are closest together and sweep those areas first.

name: You WAiNKer!
guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK app: landmarks, curiosities and sculptures. Scan every new place you pass while doing other things and the count builds up on its own.

name: One Last Thing
guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. Only 50 are needed, so skip the hardest ones and finish the easy set first.

name: Hot Together
description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level together with your partner. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a good escape: cops struggle to follow you along the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you. It unlocks once you leave the red heat zone. Robbing a bank vault gives you a 4-star level instantly, so this often pops on its own.

name: Retail Therapy
description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner while staying wanted. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well. The trophy is delayed and pops about half a minute after you leave the third store.

name: Whip It Good
guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A WAiNK scan of a new vehicle is enough to count it, so scan every unfamiliar car, bike and boat you see.

name: Gunslinger
description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
guide: Take down five enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Before the fight, buff your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, bring Adrenaline and use an assault rifle. Gang members at their illegal operations count; soldiers, police and civilians do not seem to.

name: Sneakthief
description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun from Chapter 3. Plan your entry, keep out of sight lines, and leave before the alarm goes up.

name: Maximum Withdrawal
guide: Rob five of the eight bank vaults and get away. Robbing a vault instantly gives you a 4-star wanted level, so plan your escape route before you go in.

name: A Classic Blitz Play
description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Wait for a truck on a quiet road, stop it, take the cash and break line of sight before the police close in.

name: The Goodtime State
guide: Clear the fog from the entire Leonida map by exploring every region. Drive, fly or sail through the corners of the map you have not visited yet; the fog lifts as you go.

name: Pest Control
description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
guide: Rob one Illegal Operation from each of the nine gangs; 39 operations exist in total. Hit a different gang each time and keep a note of which gangs you have done.

name: Dime on the Dollar
description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts (fences). Marked Bills come from robberies, so launder them as you earn them instead of letting them pile up.

name: Treat Yo Self
guide: Spend $100,000 across any shops. Normal purchases count, so this adds up as you buy weapons, clothes and supplies through the game.

name: Little Boxes
guide: Buy all eight purchasable garages, $160,000 in total. Save up and buy them as you find them; garages also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you register.

name: On the Spot
description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
guide: Register ten vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. Register each new vehicle you keep instead of leaving it on the street.

name: Just Like Paradise
guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It unlocks automatically as you play the story.

name: Paradise Lost
guide: Complete Chapter 1. Story trophy, unlocks automatically.

name: Tits Ass Drug Money
guide: Complete Chapter 2. Story trophy, unlocks automatically.

name: Vice City, Baby!
guide: Complete Chapter 3. Story trophy, unlocks automatically.

name: Top Of The World, Ma
guide: Complete Chapter 4. Story trophy, unlocks automatically.

name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
guide: Complete Chapter 5, the final story mission. Story trophy, unlocks automatically, and it opens the 100% Completion checklist under Progress > Stats.

name: Trust
guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. Story trophy, unlocks automatically.

name: Break the Bank
guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. Story trophy, unlocks automatically.

name: Family Matters
guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. Story trophy, unlocks automatically.

name: DWNFALL
guide: Complete the story mission Headliners in Chapter 4. Story trophy, unlocks automatically.

name: Hi-Jacked
guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. Story trophy, unlocks automatically.

name: Snow Storm
guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. Story trophy, unlocks automatically.

name: Road to Rehabilitation
description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
guide: Finish Andy's five quests; Lucia only, from Chapter 3. Complete the final mission for Andy.

name: This Was No Boat Accident
description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
guide: Clear seven shipwrecks for Kenton, from Chapter 1. Complete the final mission for Kenton.

name: The Lone Rider
description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
guide: Finish Billy's five quests at the Thrillbilly Mudclub, from Chapter 2. Complete the final mission for Billy.

name: Supply & Demand
description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
guide: Deliver all 16 cars on Randy's Wish List, from Chapter 3. Complete the final mission for Randy.

name: Spin On This!
description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
guide: Destroy the labs and finish Tyrone's last quest; Jason only, from Chapter 3. Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

name: Fair Game
description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret; Jason only. The exact animal is still being confirmed, so check your quest log when the strand appears and study animals with your binoculars as you travel.

name: Catch Me If You Can
description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
guide: Steal an airliner docked at terminals E3/E4 at VCIA and fly at least 1 km away from the airport. It unlocks once you are clear of the airport.

name: Challenging Tank
guide: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station. Drive it out of the base and the trophy pops.

name: In The Beginning…
description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
guide: Strategy from the description: the description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed, so try ordering a cocktail at a beachfront spot on Ocean Beach and watch for the pop.

name: Capital Offense
description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
guide: Strategy from the description: the description points to smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed, so try driving a car through a showroom window and out the other side.

name: Let's Go Bowling
description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
guide: Take all three key valuables from Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn and lose the police. Grab everything, then break line of sight and stay out of the wanted zone until the heat dies down.

name: Personal Best
guide: Max out Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time. Go to the gym together: while one character works out, the other trains automatically, so progress doubles.

name: Actions Speak Louder
guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. It builds up naturally as you play, so just keep playing and check the profile counter in the Progress menu.

name: Bad Luck, I Guess
guide: Strategy from the description: the description hints at a second attempt, 'Second time's the charm.' The exact trigger is still unconfirmed, so try repeating an activity that failed the first time.

name: The Truth Is Out There
guide: Strategy from the description: the description hints at something strange happening. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed, so keep an eye out for odd events while exploring Leonida.

name: Ten Pin
description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by
guide: Strategy from the description: the description points to knocking someone down with a melee drive-by. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed, so try a melee attack from a moving vehicle.
